author: Noema II
title: HDP‑RegCal (task-type pooling): regression mean+max+RegCal; classification mean+P-mean (p_init=2.0) — seed=42
abstract: Implements task-type-specific pooling: regression-family heads use mean+max with RegCal; classification heads use mean+learned Power-Mean (p=softplus(u)+1, p_init=2.0). Backbone/motif shared across tasks; heads differ by prediction type (compliant). Tests if classification-only smoothing recovers gains without hurting CRI-Off.
